mentions.name: FixBugs
mentions.description: This AI agent ingests the rich context surrounding production bugs to reproduce them in a sandbox, identify the root cause, generate a fix, verify the fix, and review generated code with multiple AI models to catch potential regressions. It is available as a self-hosted VSCode extension with full code and data privacy and zero data retention, and as a GitHub app installed per repository.
mentions.source_excerpt: FixBugs, an agent that ingests the rich context surrounding production bugs to reproduce them in a sandbox and generate verified fixes. It's available in the form of a self-hosted VSCode extension and as a Github app.
mentions.author: kirtivr
